A 69-year-old man
From the Department of Neurology, Nara Medical University, Kashihara, Japan.
At 74 years of age, the patient noticed hypertonia and bilateral synchronous myoclonus in the legs.
At 72 years of age, he had diffi culty walking, subsequently followed by the onset of dysphagia and vocal cord paralysis.
One year later, subjective mild stiffness in his legs persisted.
